findings.cause: The inherited raw native rest rotation blocks include a small non-orthogonal residual. The first recovery implementation converted absolute local transforms into normalized quaternions, then conventional FK removed that residual and changed exact native joint lengths.
findings.correction: Interpolate local skin-rotation deltas and use native fixed joint pivots/rest translations. Preserve canonical matrices, human proportions and the 1e-8m bone gate.

findings.cause: A clear palm endpoint and valid handle contact do not constrain the complete weighted finger and forearm surface trajectory. The initial upward withdrawal let C forearm sweep the conservative leaf envelope; lowering alone cleared that envelope but near-closed rest interpolation then swept fingertips into the real table. Both checks must use the entire exit path and all actual object shapes.

evidence.envelopeIsConservative: The 36mm full leaf envelope is thicker than the actual 12mm pane; its 17.9976mm result is not an actual glass penetration-depth claim.

findings.additionalVerification: Record withdrawal and rest intermediate samples in the actual body-derived solid geometry; retain separate contact, release, rest-start and final rest evidence.
findings.correction: Withdraw 0.10m downward and at least 0.12m opposite the actual palm normal. Read the actual Cannon table AABB rear edge and extend normal withdrawal until the palm target is behind that edge by 0.15m. This is a measured sufficient swept-hand allowance, not a claimed mathematical minimum. Near-closed withdrawal becomes longer; fully open withdrawal keeps the measured reachable 0.12m distance. Preserve actors, stations, physical shapes and all original numerical gates.
remainingSpecificRisks: Full canonical-head/material/GPU rendering, actual UI operation and public HTTP execution still require the current-head Chromium and publication gates.

findings.cause: The newly completed native rest motion after bottle withdrawal sweeps fingertips farther toward the table than the former partial withdrawal. A 150mm table-edge allowance cleared all release cases but still let A single and B paired-right cancellation poses touch the table.
findings.correction: Read the actual table AABB rear edge. Keep the original 30mm upward exit and at least 140mm rearward movement, but limit the exit palm to rearEdgeZ minus 190mm. Use this same helper for both lower-to-verify withdrawal and cancelled/failed task recovery.

findings.cause: Cancelling just after approach starts can leave the hand already behind the table safe plane and near its natural reach boundary. Applying the contact-exit downward offset anyway commands an unreachable target.
findings.correction: Only when firstContactErrorM is exactly null and the actual palm is behind the actual table rear safe plane, start native rest directly. Read the existing physical table body even when support collision is disabled. Record a no-contact direct-rest mode and do not fabricate a withdrawal event. Actual-contact cancellation retains the full measured withdrawal.

findings.cause: The inherited R01 contact camera lies on the far side of the newly introduced R02 window frame. Actual contact-A/B/C images show the near vertical frame and table edge hiding the bottle and gripping palm, even though the motion and data gates pass.
findings.correction: Move only the bottle-contact observation camera to the open left side and raise its elevation. Keep all humans, object geometry, materials, visibility, poses, physics and acceptance thresholds unchanged. Use the measured actual source-to-target release path to choose the left-side angle, including extended fingers while opening the grip at the target.
findings.requiredRecheck: Full existing same-source browser suite, explicit independent inspection of A/B/C contact screenshots, and exact public URL browser acceptance before delivery.

findings.cause: The first R02 bottle placement target at x=0.10,z=0.44 left the open native index finger inside the separate closed window handle. The inherited bottle audit measured the operated bottle and tabletop, and window.solidBoxes excluded cylinders. Numeric success did not imply clearance against this omitted physical object.

evidence.witnessKind: Actual browser-rendered finger surface anchors; not a whole-hand maximum

findings.correction: Sample actual weighted hand and forearm surface vertices against oriented finite non-operated cylinders, include them in the unchanged other-solid 3mm gate, and preserve per-object sample counts, transforms, dimensions and witnesses. Bottle tasks include the actual window handle; window tasks include the actual bottle. Keep the operated cylinder separate under the existing assisted-contact contract. Record bottle withdrawal and rest intermediate and terminal poses by task start time. Move the two table targets outside the window handle release envelope without altering native bones or stations.

firstLayoutFailure.decision: Reject this otherwise collision-clear target because the native low reach is clamped; do not adjust bone lengths or pose-error gates.

findings.requiredRecheck: Full current-production native paths at both targets and all supported stations; strengthened full browser suite and exact public browser verification. Prior 29b3 programmatic/public passes remain historical and do not satisfy this new object-coverage check.

findings.cause: Every-1/120s native production sampling found two peaks missed by phase-only observations: the straight low open-hand approach grazed the table edge; during fastest transfer, generic LockConstraint equations retained Cannon 1/60s SPOOK coefficients while the actual world ran at 1/120s. The latter produced a moving-palm lead into the real bottle.

evidence.sourceScope: The numerical failure belongs to the explicitly hashed local production world derived from the first browser candidate; it is not claimed to be a measurement of that earlier commit.

findings.correction: Keep the original approach endpoints and 1.4s duration, adding a 40mm-peak vertical arc 4*smooth(u)*(1-smooth(u)). Set each existing grip equation to the original stiffness 1e7 and relaxation 4 with the actual dt before solving. Preserve the 24N/axis and 0.8Nm/axis limits and all native geometry; no physical bottle transform is overwritten.

findings.cause: When closing an already-open leaf, a direct diagonal path from native rest to the handle sent open fingers through the handle before palm contact. The previous held-contact gate did not cover this pre-contact interval.

Preserve original matrices, finite reach and actual approach surface evidence; do not write the window body transform.
